BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nakuru

2. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   D. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

4. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   C. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.
   D. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.

5. Which statement about Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of.
   B. Treat Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of as rumours only.
   C. Explain Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Business Activities 2.2 Types of Business Ownership 2.3 Social Responsibility of never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   C. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.
   D. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   B. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.
   D. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.
   B. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   C. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions 4.2 Effects of Business Transactions 4.3 Source Documents  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Effects of Business Transactions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
